title: Wikipedia article summary
description: Reads the lead summary of one Wikipedia article in Russian or English by its exact title: the canonical title, a short description, the lead extract and the article URL. Reports disambiguation pages and missing articles instead of guessing. Use it for a quick, citable definition of a well-known subject.
when_not_to_use: Recent events, niche community or gaming subjects that Wikipedia does not cover, opinions, private people, and questions that need more than the article's lead section.
output_description: title, description, extract (lead text, at most 1500 characters), url, and disambiguation (true when the title names several subjects).
